title: SPARC shared contract schemas
description: Canonical SPARC schemas. Patterns constrain shape only; server code must still resolve identifiers through approved catalogues and perform domain validation before I/O.

Bbox.description: RFC 7946 order: west, south, east, north.

PeriodInput.description: The server additionally validates real calendar dates, ordering, supported archive bounds, maximum span and comparison-period compatibility before I/O.

disclaimer.const: This boundary is suitable for prototype analysis but is not an authoritative legal or cadastral boundary.

detail.description: Safe human-readable detail; never include stack traces, filesystem paths, environment values, internal hosts, credentials, tokens or signed URLs.
